PLAN "Bodyweight Strength Foundations (No Equipment)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight exercises"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Fundamentals" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          jumping_jacks 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row_doorway 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying_spinal_twist 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          high_knees 3m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_push_up 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          negative_pull_up 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child's_pose 2m
    WEEK 2:
